note: ⛔ THREE FAMILIES. Erik 2026-08-24: 'boil things down a bit, BACK TO THE POLE AXES as a guide for what types there are… ELEMENTAL is heat, cold, lightning, etc. Look up how other RPGs have allocated damage types.' ⚠️ D&D 5e's thirteen fall into three groups — three PHYSICAL, six ELEMENTAL, four POLAR — and its own variant rules state the principle: 'radiant and necrotic channel positive and negative energy respectively' and 'force and psychic can be seen as opposites'. ⛔ SO NOT EVERY TYPE IS ON AN AXIS, which was the error in Aevi's first table and the thing CCode caught from the other side: cold and fire are both TAKINGS, which is exactly why neither is polar. They are SIBLINGS. A ward against fire is not a ward against ice.

physical.what: ⛔ EDGE, WEIGHT, IMPACT — the default when no type is named, and the only harm a shield answers plainly.
physical._why: ⚠️ OWNED BY NOBODY. Any tradition reaches it through its own idiom — an Ashwarden conjures bone (`bone_lance`) and a Marcher swings a blade, and the ward is the same in both cases.

elemental.what: ⛔ HOW THE WORLD HURTS YOU. Not a tradition's signature — a medium any tradition can reach through its own method.
elemental._why: ⛔ SIBLINGS, NOT OPPOSITES. `cold` and `heat` are both TAKINGS and neither is the other's plus — that is CCode's objection turned into the structure rather than argued with. ⚠️ AND THIS RECLASSIFIES `cold`, which Aevi authored as Death's own on 2026-08-24: Death REACHES it ('your body goes cold when you die') and so does anyone else. Blazeborn reaches `heat` hardest; that is why 7 blazeborn harm crafts sat untyped.

polar.what: ⛔ ONE PAIR PER AXIS, WHERE THE AXIS HAS TWO REAL ENDS. A polar type has an opposite; a sibling does not.

pairs._why: ⛔ AN ENDING HASTENED against GROWTH TURNED. And it is why HEALING NEEDS NO TYPE — Erik 2026-08-24: healing is an EFFECT, and the SOURCE type decides who it mends. `decay` mends the undead; `living` and `vitality` mend the living. `absorb` already implements exactly this.
⚠️ Erik: 'APPETITE AND FEELINGS ARE SOMETHING OPPOSITE POLE FROM Mind, logic, thinking, psionic.' ⛔ VISCERAL against CEREBRAL — `appetite` folds in as visceral rather than holding a type of its own.

⚠️ `radiance` IS NOT `heat`. CCode measured it: 6 of 7 blazeborn harm crafts use burn language while `radiant_folk`'s light is about ILLUMINATION AND BEING SEEN. Burning and shining are the same source and different harms — burning is elemental `heat`, shining is polar `radiance`.
⚠️ `appetite` is kept as the DEMONIC pole and reads as visceral in the emotional sense — Erik: 'appetite is visceral, as are all the other feelings.' It pairs against moral weight.
⛔ 26 unmaker+wright crafts, a whole reach, entirely untyped. NEITHER TYPE EXISTS YET — authored here as the axis demands them, and each tradition's audit types its own crafts.

⚠️ `physical` appears here AND in its own family — that is correct and not a duplicate. It is the untyped default AND the concrete pole; the mason reaches it as a signature where a marcher reaches it as a weapon.

⚠️ THE WEAKEST PAIR IN THE TABLE and flagged as such. `temporal` is duration taken; `precursor` is the lattice worked directly. They share an axis in the tradition map and may not share one here — ERIK'S CALL, and nothing should be typed against this pair until he rules.

polar._unpairedWhy: ⛔ `vitality` IS THE ONLY CONSERVED TYPE — minus here and plus there in the same act, which is why it belongs to no axis. It is a TRANSFER ALONG ANY of them. Two carriers across two traditions: `draw_down` (ashwarden) takes life to mend himself; `consumed_wound` (abyssal) is OFFERED a wound and takes it away. Same conservation, opposite consent.

_notATypeAtAll: ⛔ HEALING, AND METHOD. Healing is an EFFECT whose source type decides who it mends (see death_life). And PSIONICS IS A METHOD, NOT A TYPE — Erik: 'psionics are a METHOD of causing types of damage; a psionic blast can be PARTIALLY PHYSICAL.' ⚠️ Three things kept apart: POWER SOURCE (what you draw on), METHOD (how you deliver it), DAMAGE TYPE (what lands and what the ward answers).
_incapacitatingIsNotDamage: ⛔ A CRAFT THAT STOPS WITHOUT WOUNDING HAS NO DAMAGE TYPE — it has a RESIST type. `progression.js` glosses `incapacitating` as 'STOPS a threat; it does not wound it… NEVER a cut or a break', and `impositionOf` already resolves `resist: mental|physical`. ⚠️ That takes 57 crafts out of the typing job entirely and means a soak-ward was never the right answer to a binding.
